scope: the 7 receivers from the inbound payload schemas pass with wire-derived BCS-S-0019..0025 struct entries
summary: Paired each receiver struct from the inbound payload schemas pass with its Receive() apply method (slot 1 for 6 of 7 receivers; slot 2 for the 5-slot ChangeActorSubStatStatus). Decomped both the Receive and its direct helper. The 7 receivers split into 3 patterns: (1) Direct CharaBase sub-struct writers (0x013D writes CharaBase+0x60[0/0x58/0x59]; 0x0144 writes CharaBase+0xDC+0x18; 0x0145 writes CharaBase+0xDC+0x10 and bit-fires _onChangeNetStat*). (2) Indirect via vtable / lookup (0x0136 SetEventStatus does a vtable[9] call on a looked-up state object; 0x0137 SyncMemory updates a separate sync-cache via FUN_00775A30; 0x0179 ChangeActorSubStatStatus is gated through a 5-slot pattern and routes via FUN_00707D60 at depth 4). (3) Direct field write to known offset (0x017B writes target+0x5d already recorded in data_dependency_catalog from BCS-Y-0278). The header-only-delta hypothesis from the inbound payload schemas pass is CONFIRMED for 0x0179 (wire body all-zero; meaningful state comes from header src + opcode) and 0x017B (wire byte always 0; the write is effectively a 'clear flag' triggered by header).
